subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The student thought about this during exam week.”?
options: Students liked the clock because it made them feel less late.
He did not feel like studying, but he remembered Mr. Kuo.
A powerful idea can make a familiar place feel like a responsibility.
Teachers forgot to check the clock, and many classes kept studying.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The student thought about this during exam week. He did not feel like studying, but he remembered Mr. Kuo.」，答案為「He did not feel like studying, but he remembered Mr. Kuo.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「He did not feel like studying, but he remembered Mr. Kuo.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
